meta_data.base_class: Find professional repair services for specific <appliances> - refers to various large household products that have dedicated repair services.

tool_template.name: Professional<class>RepairServiceFinder
tool_template.description: Find professional repair services for <class> issues.

location.description: The user's location to find nearby repair services.

include_ratings.description: Whether to include ratings of the repair services.

service_type.description: Type of service needed for the <class> (e.g., noise reduction, odor removal, component inspection).

warranty_status.description: The warranty status of the <class>, which can affect repair service options, including 'In Warranty' or 'Out of Warranty'.

service_speed_preference.description: The preferred speed of service for the repair of the <class>. One of the following options: 'Standard', 'Express', 'Urgent'.

preferred_contact_method.description: The preferred method of contact for updates regarding the repair service for the <class>. One of the following options: 'Email', 'Phone', 'Text Message'.

budget_limit.description: The maximum budget available for repair services for the <class>.
